name: Rate 50
definition: Provides information about the rates related to securities movement.

AdditionalTax.name: Additional Tax
AdditionalTax.definition: Rate used for additional tax that cannot be categorised.

GrossDistributionRate.name: Gross Distribution Rate
GrossDistributionRate.definition: Distribution rate before tax has been deducted.

GrossInterestRateUsedForPayment.name: Gross Interest Rate Used For Payment
GrossInterestRateUsedForPayment.definition: The actual interest rate before tax used for the payment of the interest for the specified interest period. |Usage guideline: It is used to provide the applicable rate for the current payment, after all calculations have been performed, that is, application of period and method of interest computation.

WithholdingTaxRate.name: Withholding Tax Rate
WithholdingTaxRate.definition: Percentage of a cash distribution that will be withheld by the tax authorities of the jurisdiction of the issuer, for which a relief at source and/or reclaim may be possible.

SecondLevelTax.name: Second Level Tax
SecondLevelTax.definition: Rate at which the income will be withheld by a jurisdiction other than the jurisdiction of the issuer’s country of tax incorporation, for which a relief at source and/or reclaim may be possible. It is levied in complement or offset of the withholding tax rate (TAXR) levied by the jurisdiction of the issuer’s tax domicile.

ChargesFees.name: Charges Fees
ChargesFees.definition: Rate used to calculate the amount of the charges/fees that cannot be categorised.

EarlySolicitationFeeRate.name: Early Solicitation Fee Rate
EarlySolicitationFeeRate.definition: Cash rate made available, as an incentive, in addition to the solicitation fee, in order to encourage early participation in an offer.

FiscalStamp.name: Fiscal Stamp
FiscalStamp.definition: Percentage of fiscal tax to apply.

ThirdPartyIncentiveRate.name: Third Party Incentive Rate
ThirdPartyIncentiveRate.definition: Cash rate made available in an event in order to encourage participation in the offer. As information, payment is made to a third party who has solicited an entity to take part in the offer.

NetDistributionRate.name: Net Distribution Rate
NetDistributionRate.definition: Distribution rate after tax has been deducted.

ApplicableRate.name: Applicable Rate
ApplicableRate.definition: Rate applicable to the event announced, for example, redemption rate for a redemption event.

SolicitationFeeRate.name: Solicitation Fee Rate
SolicitationFeeRate.definition: Rate of the cash premium made available if the securities holder consents or participates to an event, for example consent fees or solicitation fee.

TaxCreditRate.name: Tax Credit Rate
TaxCreditRate.definition: Amount of money per equity allocated as the result of a tax credit.

TaxOnIncome.name: Tax On Income
TaxOnIncome.definition: Overall tax withheld at source by fund managers prior to considering the tax obligation of each unit holder.

TaxOnProfits.name: Tax On Profits
TaxOnProfits.definition: Taxation applied on an amount clearly identified as capital profits, capital gains.

TaxReclaimRate.name: Tax Reclaim Rate
TaxReclaimRate.definition: Percentage of cash that was paid in excess of actual tax obligation and was reclaimed.

EqualisationRate.name: Equalisation Rate
EqualisationRate.definition: Portion of the fund distribution which represents the average accrued income included in the purchase price for units bought during the account period.

DeemedRate.name: Deemed Rate
DeemedRate.definition: Rate applied for the calculation of deemed proceeds which are not paid to security holders but on which withholding tax is applicable.

NetDistributionRate1Rule.definition: If NetDistributionRate is repeated, then:|- RateTypeAndAmountAndRateStatus/RateType/Code values must all be different in each occurrence of NetDistributionRate. (MT 564 NVR C8).

GrossDistributionRate2Rule.definition: If GrossDDistributionRate is repeated, then:|- RateTypeAndAmountAndRateStatus/RateType/Code values must all be different in each occurrence of GrossDistributionRate. (MT 564 NVR C8).

GrossDistributionRate3Rule.definition: Only a single occurrence of either GrossDistributionRate/Amount or GrossGrossDistributionRate/AmountAndRateStatus or GrossGrossDistributionRate/NotSpecifiedRate may be present, and only one of these elements may be present.|(MT 564 NVR C7).

NetDistributionRate2Rule.definition: Only a single occurrence of either NetDistributionRate/Amount or NetDistributionRate/AmountAndRateStatus or NetDistributionRate/NotSpecifiedRate may be present, and only one of these elements may be present.|(MT 564 NVR C7).

SecondLevelTax3Rule.definition: If at least one occurrence of SecondLevelTax is present, then at least one occurrence of WithholdingTaxRate must be present. (MT 564 NVR C19).

SecondLevelTax1Rule.definition: If SecondLevelTax is repeated, then SecondLevelTax/RateTypeAndRate/RateType/Code values must all be different in each occurrence of SecondLevelTax. |(MT 564 NVR C8).

SecondLevelTax2Rule.definition: Only a single occurrence of either SecondLevelTax/Amount or SecondLevelTax/Rate or SecondLevelTax/NotSpecifiedRate may be present, only one of these elements may be present. |(MT 564 NVR C7).

WithholdingTaxRate1Rule.definition: If WithholdingTaxRate is repeated, then WithholdingTaxRate/RateTypeAndRate/RateType/Code values must all be different in each occurrence of WithholdingTaxRate. |(MT 564 NVR C8).

WithholdingTaxRate2Rule.definition: Only a single occurrence of either WithholdingTaxRate/Amount or WithholdingTaxRate/Rate or WithholdingTaxRate/NotSpecifiedRate may be present, only one of these elements may be present. |(MT 564 NVR C7).

DeemedRate1Rule.definition: If DeemedRate is repeated, then DeemedRate/RateTypeAndAmountAndRateStatus/RateType/Code values and DeemedRate/RateTypeAndRate/RateType/Code values must all be different in each occurrence of DeemedRate. |(MT 564 NVR C8).

DeemedRate2Rule.definition: Only a single occurrence of either DeemedRate/Amount or DeemedRate/Rate or DeemedRate/NotSpecifiedRate may be present, only one of these elements may be present. |(MT 564 NVR C7).
